name: 池底清淤周期（有机质累积）

map.根据池塘面积、水深、放养密度和投饵率估算有机质累积速率，计算推荐清淤周期，追踪清: Compute the pond desilting cycle from organic matter accumulation.
map.📖 查看「养殖池塘清淤周期管理使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pond Desilting Cycle Management Guide"
map.暂无池塘，请先添加: No ponds yet, please add one first
map.1. 每亩日投饵量 = 放养密度 × 平均体重(估0.5kg) × 投饵率: 1. Daily feed per mu = stocking density × average body weight (assumed 0.5 kg) × feeding rate
map.2. 有机质残留率约 30%（未食及排泄转化）: 2. The organic matter residual rate is about 30% (uneaten feed and excretion converted)
map.3. 月累积量 = 日投饵量 × 30 × 残留率: 3. Monthly accumulation = daily feed × 30 × residual rate
map.4. 累积浓度 = 累积量 ÷ (面积 × 水深 × 667) ，单位 mg/L: 4. Accumulated concentration = accumulation ÷ (area × depth × 667), in mg/L
map.5. 当浓度超过 15 mg/L 建议清淤，据此反推周期: 5. When the concentration exceeds 15 mg/L, desilting is recommended; back-calculate the cycle from this
map.注：此为简化估算模型，实际需结合底泥厚度、水温、溶氧等综合判断。: Note: this is a simplified estimation model; in practice judge together with sediment thickness, water temperature, dissolved oxygen and other factors.
map.本工具基于简化估算模型，实际清淤决策需结合底泥厚度检测、水质指标、养殖品种等因素: This tool uses a simplified estimation model; actual desilting decisions should combine sediment thickness tests, water-quality indicators, farmed species and other factors.
map.有机质残留率按 30% 估算，实际因饲料类型、摄食情况、水温等差异较大: The organic matter residual rate is assumed to be 30%; in practice it varies widely with feed type, feeding behaviour and water temperature.
map.临界浓度 15 mg/L 为经验参考值，高密度养殖可适当降低阈值: The 15 mg/L critical concentration is an empirical reference; high-density farming may lower the threshold.
map.清淤后点击「标记今日已清淤」可重置倒计时: After desilting, click "Mark desilted today" to reset the countdown.
map.📚 深度解析：养殖池塘清淤周期管理: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Pond Desilting Cycle Management
map.多池塘集中管理，按面积/水深/密度/投饵率估算有机质累积: Manage multiple ponds centrally and estimate organic matter accumulation from area, depth, density and feeding rate.
map.预警淤泥临界浓度，安排清淤与复养间隔: Warn on the critical sediment concentration and plan desilting and restocking intervals.
map.结合上次清淤日期推算下次清淤时间与风险等级: Combine the last desilting date to project the next desilting time and risk level.
map.10 亩精养塘月度核算: Monthly accounting for a 10-mu intensive pond
map.以 10 亩、水深 2 m、放养 500 尾/亩、日投饵率 1% 为例：日投饵约: Taking 10 mu, 2 m deep, 500 fish per mu and a 1% daily feeding rate: daily feed is about 25 kg, the monthly organic matter residue (at 30%) is about 225 kg, the water body is 13340 m³ and the monthly concentration increase is about 16.9 mg/L; at the critical 15 mg/L this reaches the limit in about 27 days, so desilt monthly and strengthen sludge discharge.
map.清淤周期怎么算？: How is the desilting cycle calculated?
map.按投饵量×残留率得月有机质累积，除以水量得月浓度增量，再用临界浓度(15 mg/: Multiply the feed by the residual rate to get the monthly organic matter accumulation, divide by the water volume to get the monthly concentration increase, then use the critical concentration (15 mg/L) to back-calculate the allowed number of months; high-density intensive farming shortens this markedly.
map.看距上次清淤以来累积浓度占临界(15 mg/L)的比例：<60% 低、60~90: The ratio of the concentration accumulated since the last desilting to the critical value (15 mg/L): <60% low, 60-90% medium, ≥90% high; a high level calls for immediate desilting or strong sludge discharge.
map.水产养殖池塘底质管理工具。通过输入池塘面积、水深、放养密度和投饵率，估算底泥有机: An aquaculture pond substrate management tool. By entering pond area, water depth, stocking density and feeding rate it estimates the sediment organic matter accumulation rate and concentration increase, computes the recommended desilting cycle, tracks progress since the last desilting and gives three-level low/medium/high risk warnings, helping farmers schedule desilting scientifically and prevent water-quality deterioration.
